name: cpe
description: A CPE 2.3 formatted string: cpe:2.3: then the eleven attributes part, vendor, product, version, update, edition, language, sw_edition, target_sw, target_hw and other, 13 colon-separated fields in all. The part is a (application), o (operating system) or h (hardware); each attribute is * (any), - (not applicable) or text of letters, digits, '_', '.', '-' and backslash-escaped punctuation, with * and ? as wildcards. Whether the vendor or product exists is not checked.
